SDN.note: IMEX is an import/export system; no e-procurement stated.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Sudan's director general of policies says payment systems were reformed by reactivating the Siraj instant gross settlement system and partially reinstating the national switching system.

SDN.note: No consumer-protection rule for digital finance stated.
Only foreign transactions and import/export transfers generally; no digital corridor or regional system.
No government payments to people stated.
Mentions displaced persons only in passing; no registration or access stated.
The national switch is not stated to connect wallets and banks; no mobile money stated.
